title: Conormal sequence for a symmetric algebra of a projective quotient conormal module
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $P=R[x_1,\dots,x_n]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], and $A=P/I$, where $I=(f_1,\dots,f_m)$. Put $M=I/I^2$, an $A$-module, and assume $M$ is projective (a direct summand of a free $A$-module). Let $q:A^{\oplus m}\to M$ send the $j$th basis vector to $f_j\bmod I^2$, and let $K=\ker q$. Put $C=\operatorname{Sym}_A(M)$ [lem-weil-pbc-symmetric-algebra-universal-property]. Let $Q=P[y_1,\dots,y_m]$, let $Q\to C$ extend $P\to A\to C$ and send $y_j$ to the canonical image of $q(e_j)$ in $C$, and put $J=\ker(Q\to C)$. Then $Q\to C$ is surjective, and there is a split exact sequence of $C$-modules $$0\to M\otimes_A C\longrightarrow J/J^2\longrightarrow K\otimes_A C\to0.$$ The first map sends $(f\bmod I^2)\otimes c$ to $c(f\bmod J^2)$, using $I\subseteq J$. The second is induced by reducing $Q\to A[y_1,\dots,y_m]$ modulo $I$ and identifying the conormal module of the resulting presentation of $C$ with $K\otimes_A C$. In particular $J/J^2\cong (M\oplus K)\otimes_A C\cong C^{\oplus m}$.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Lemma Tag 07CE (lemma-improve-presentation), lines 357-414, especially equation-sequence and its splitting in lines 369-414. The projective case repairs the use of More on Algebra Lemma Tag 07EV: its general claim K tensor C = J/J^2 is false, as recorded in lem-weil-pbc-cotangent-complex-symmetric-algebra. Here q splits, so locally M and K are free, the linear relations corresponding to a basis of K are coordinate variables, and the conormal sequence is exact on the left. Algebra Lemma Tag 00S2 supplies the right-exact sequence.
